parameters.query:
UPDATE contacts SET owner_id = COALESCE(owner_id, (
  SELECT u.id FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN contacts c2 ON c2.owner_id = u.id AND c2.is_archived = false
  WHERE u.role = 'user' AND u.active = true
  GROUP BY u.id
  ORDER BY COUNT(c2.id) ASC, u.id ASC
  LIMIT 1
)), updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING owner_id;

nodes.name: Assign Owner (Round Robin): Booking
nodes.notes: Parity fix: book-inspection-generic already round-robin-assigns an owner when one is missing; the token-based public path previously required an owner to already be set (from earlier contact creation) or rejected the booking outright with a misleading 'invalid link' error. COALESCE never overwrites an existing owner.
